name: CJIS Markings High Confidence
description: Explicit CJIS / CHRI / LES banner or portion markings — high-confidence indicator that the content is CJI regardless of payload.
expression: (D:CJIS Marking Pattern (High Confidence) OR D:Law Enforcement Sensitive (LES) Markings)

name: CJIS Markings Medium Confidence
description: Looser CJIS keyword match — pairs with content indicators in other engines to cut false positives from casual mentions.

name: CJIS Identifier Engine
description: Structured CJIS identifiers — NCIC ORI, FBI UCN, State ID, NCIC Purpose Code. Any of these appearing in content is a strong signal.
expression: (D:NCIC ORI Pattern OR D:FBI UCN / Universal Control Number OR D:State ID Number (SID) Reference OR D:NCIC Purpose Code Pattern)

name: Criminal History / RAP Sheet Engine
description: RAP-sheet / criminal-history terminology correlated with subject PII (SSN, DL, or DOB) within 500 chars. Suppresses matches on news articles that casually mention arrests.
expression: (D:Criminal History / RAP Sheet Phrases AND (D:Social Security Numbers (US) - CJIS Prox 500 OR D:Drivers License (US) - CJIS Prox 500 OR D:Date of Birth - CJIS Prox 500))

name: NCIC / III Data Engine
description: NCIC or III query/response terminology correlated with subject PII — indicates a live CJI data transfer.
expression: (D:NCIC / III Query Terminology AND (D:Social Security Numbers (US) - CJIS Prox 500 OR D:Drivers License (US) - CJIS Prox 500 OR D:Date of Birth - CJIS Prox 500))

name: Warrant / Wanted-Person Engine
description: Warrant/wanted terminology near subject PII — extradition, bench, arrest warrants referencing a named subject.
expression: (D:Warrant / Wanted-Person Phrases AND (D:Social Security Numbers (US) - CJIS Prox 500 OR D:Drivers License (US) - CJIS Prox 500 OR D:Date of Birth - CJIS Prox 500))

name: Biometric CJI Engine
description: Biometric identifiers (fingerprint, palm, AFIS, NGI) with CJIS markings or any structured CJIS identifier — indicates fingerprint card or biometric record.
expression: (D:Biometric / AFIS Terminology AND (D:CJIS Marking Pattern (High Confidence) OR D:NCIC ORI Pattern OR D:FBI UCN / Universal Control Number))

name: NICS Firearms Background Engine
description: NICS / firearm background-check terminology — ATF Form 4473, NICS denial, prohibited-person language.

name: Info-Sharing Portal Engine
description: Exfil of N-DEx, LEEP, or Nlets derived content references — info-sharing-system terminology co-occurring with subject identifiers.
expression: (D:N-DEx / Criminal-Justice Info Sharing AND (D:Social Security Numbers (US) - CJIS Prox 500 OR D:NCIC ORI Pattern OR D:FBI UCN / Universal Control Number))

name: CJIS Any-Signal Engine
description: Any strong CJIS signal — explicit markings, structured identifiers, or RAP/NCIC/warrant content engines. Catch-all for broad monitoring.
expression: (D:CJIS Marking Pattern (High Confidence) OR D:Law Enforcement Sensitive (LES) Markings OR D:NCIC ORI Pattern OR D:FBI UCN / Universal Control Number OR D:NCIC Purpose Code Pattern)
